audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read 'Skill' under a why-line saying Level 1 favours Volibear, and rows 5 and 6 read Volibear/Skill under why-lines that hand both stages to Camille.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Volibear x5 then Camille, Camille — which is exactly what whys[0], whys[5] and whys[6] already say.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and mid credited Stormbringer with attack speed, and no Camille cooldown was given anywhere.
audit.why: Stormbringer: leap, slow, damage, bonus Health, tower disable. Attack speed is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Stormbringer 160s, The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90s, Hookshot 16/15/14/13/12s, Tactical Sweep 15/14/13/12/11s and Thundering Smash 12s written into spikes, mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributed Camille's shield to her Q and called Volibear's Q a flip; it also never stated that Hookshot needs a wall or that her heal is the outer half of Tactical Sweep.
audit.why: Adaptive Defenses (passive) shields on basic attacks against the target's damage type. Precision Protocol is an auto reset whose delayed second hit carries the true damage. Hookshot pulls her to a WALL. Tactical Sweep only heals off enemies in the OUTER half of the cone — standing close denies it. Thundering Smash stuns on the first attack he lands, not on a flip.
audit.corrected: Rewritten into spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3], mid, late, whys[4], wants.you[1], wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Camille to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Her first item picks the trades: Adaptive Defenses shields her against your damage type every time she attacks you.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Camille can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: Two items in, The Hextech Ultimatum (140s) anchors you where she wants you and Precision Protocol's delayed hit adds true damage. Don't duel her alone.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you — your R walks through her E stun and Q true damage.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you — Stormbringer's health and tower disable turn a dive.

edits.before: You out-body Camille early: bait her Q, then W-proc and E on top before she can wind up the second empowered auto — her sustain can't match yours pre-items.
edits.after: You out-body Camille early: her heal is Tactical Sweep's outer cone (15s), so stand close and it never lands. Bait Precision Protocol's delayed second hit.

edits.before: Your R attack speed and health let you walk through her E stun and Q true-damage; all-in now while she's still squishy and her R is on cooldown.
edits.after: Stormbringer (160s) gives bonus health and disables her tower — dive her at 6 while The Hextech Ultimatum (140s) is down and she is still squishy.

edits.before: Her Sheen and E-stun spike flips the lane — her hookshot engage and Q shield let her pick her trades and dive you when your R is down.
edits.after: Her first item flips the lane — Hookshot (16s) needs a wall to fire, and Adaptive Defenses shields her against whichever damage type you deal.

edits.before: Camille scales hard: her R isolates you, E stun locks your flip, and her Q true damage shreds you, so play safe and don't sidelane alone into her.
edits.after: Camille scales hard: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you in place and Precision Protocol's delayed second hit deals true damage — don't sidelane alone.

edits.before: Through 6 you keep the edge. Your R's attack speed and health let you walk through her E stun and Q true damage, so all-in while she's squishy and her R is down. This is your last strong window before her spikes.
edits.after: Through 6 you keep the edge. Thundering Smash (12s) stuns on your first attack, so close in before you swing, then Frenzied Maul twice on the same mark for the heal. All-in while The Hextech Ultimatum is down.

edits.before: After her first item the lane flips. Her Sheen-empowered autos, E hookshot engage, and Q shield let her pick trades, and her R isolation plus true damage shred you in the sidelane. Play safe, group, and don't duel her alone once she's itemized.
edits.after: After her first item the lane flips. Adaptive Defenses shields her against your damage type on every attack, Hookshot picks the engage off any wall, and The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you for the true damage. Don't duel her alone.

edits.before: Q-flip her before she can E-stun you
edits.after: Stun her before the Hookshot knockup

edits.before: Trade when her Q shield is on cooldown
edits.after: Trade when Tactical Sweep is on cooldown

edits.before: E-stun to cancel your Q flip and combo
edits.after: Knock you up with Hookshot mid-combo

notes: Camille's R carries 'channel' and 'untargetable' derived flags, but Riot's text describes only a dash to the target that anchors them plus bonus on-hit magic damage. I asserted neither an interruptible channel nor untargetability. Standing INSIDE Tactical Sweep's inner half to deny the heal is the highest-value line in this matchup and it was completely absent before.
